When Personal Assistant is active, this weapon has better target acquisition and deals significantly more precision damage.

Grants the following benefits while Personal Assistant is active:
• 18.35% increased damage
• 31.34% increased precision damage
• ? Aim Assist
• 50% decreased Flinch, Recoil, and Accuracy Cone Size

Buff lasts for 1 second after being off-target.
